qualifications.judgment: Accept the recommended revision. Görüntü işleme is the normal noun phrase for image processing; için gerekli bir bileşen makes this an unnamed component required for that work. Kullanılamıyor appropriately reports unavailability without inventing its cause. Görüntü içe aktarılmadı explicitly reports that the image was not imported, using the catalogue’s established içe aktarma terminology. This removes the original görüntü bileşeni ambiguity with an image constituent or channel. Both complete sentences were reviewed against the English source; the wording is semantically faithful and grammatically sound. The complete recommendation does not identify a colour converter, provider outage, document mutation, or recovery promise. Model-based cross-review; not human native-speaker certification. Existing colour_converter_unavailable values must remain unchanged.
